spl_product_data_elements: Aloe Vera Gel Lidocaine HCl, Menthol WATER ALCOHOL POLYSORBATE 20 GLYCERIN ALOE VERA LEAF CARBOMER HOMOPOLYMER, UNSPECIFIED TYPE SULISOBENZONE SODIUM HYDROXIDE BENZYL ALCOHOL PHENOXYETHANOL FD&C BLUE NO. 1 LIDOCAINE HYDROCHLORIDE LIDOCAINE LIDOCAINE HYDROCHLORIDE ANHYDROUS MENTHOL MENTHOL
indications_and_usage: Uses for the temporary relief of pain and itching associated with minor burns sunburn minor cuts scrapes insect bites minor skin irritations
do_not_use: Do not use in large quantities, particularly over raw surfaces or blistered areas
when_using: When using this product avoid contact with the eyes
stop_use: Stop use and ask a doctor if condition worsens, or if symptoms persist for more than 7 days or clear up and occur again within a few days
keep_out_of_reach_of_children: Keep out of reach of children If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away.
dosage_and_administration: Directions adults and children 2 years of age and older: apply to affected area not more than 3 to 4 times daily children under 2 years of age: ask a doctor
inactive_ingredient: Inactive ingredients water, alcohol denat., polysorbate 20, glycerin, Aloe barbadensis leaf juice, carbomer, benzophenone-4, sodium hydroxide, benzyl alcohol, phenoxyethanol, blue 1
